xml_snippets.Title: Clawer (GauranlenTreeModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: clawer

xml_snippets.Title: Barkskin (GauranlenTreeModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: barkskin
xml_snippets.Description Originale: A dryad caste specialized in absorbing hits during combat. Barkskin dryads are covered by a thick bark-like hide which is partly formed by the Gauranlen tree itself. Under human influence, it can act as a damage-absorbing fighter.

xml_snippets.Title: Woodmaker (GauranlenTreeModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: woodmaker
xml_snippets.Description Originale: A slow, bumbling caste of dryad which specializes in wood production. Together with its Gauranlen tree, this dryad can generate a wood-like material on an ongoing basis. However, it is slow and ineffective at work or combat.

xml_snippets.Title: Gaumaker (GauranlenTreeModeDef)
